introduction: Oregon utility-bill assistance is delivered by local Community Action agencies. OHCS funds the programs but does not approve individual household applications.
description: Oregon utility-bill assistance is delivered by local Community Action agencies. OHCS funds the programs but does not approve individual household applications.

sections.who: Local intake assesses household finances and the relevant energy program. Ask which assistance applies to your utility and circumstances.
sections.get: Approved payments go to the utility on the household’s behalf and can help prevent or restore loss of service.
sections.docs:
• Household income.
  • Utility account and energy bills.
  • Any disconnect notice and provider checklist items.
sections.apply:
1. Find your provider

    Use OHCS’s Community Action link.

  2. Ask about intake

    Explain the bill, utility and urgency; confirm available funding and appointments.

  3. Submit local records

    Keep the application confirmation and answer follow-up requests.
sections.after: Stay in contact with the utility while your application is pending and read the provider’s decision.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Energy assistance and local intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does OHCS directly approve my application?
No. Its page states local agencies determine eligibility and award help.
The utility company receives payment on the customer’s behalf.
The state page links the Community Action agency serving your location.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
